_readme: Case-study content for the new Projects API. Keyed by each project's current _id. Sent with scripts/update-projects.mjs (PATCH /api/projects/:id). Repo facts (commits, dates, languages, team size) come from the GitHub repos as of 2026-11-20. Fields not listed here are left unchanged, including images.

6ac93b1772de6872c88bbad4.title: Journal Awards: Journalism Awards Management System
6ac93b1772de6872c88bbad4.summary: An end-to-end platform that runs a journalists' syndicate's awards: award cycles, online applications and fees, jury scoring, results and grievances.
6ac93b1772de6872c88bbad4.description:
An end-to-end system that runs a journalists' syndicate's journalism awards, from setting up an award cycle to publishing ranked winners.
Admins define award cycles, types and branches, each with its own eligibility conditions, fees, weighted evaluation criteria and winner ranks. Members apply online, upload their work and pay the application fee; every application then goes to its branch's jury committee, where each juror scores it on a personal evaluation sheet. The system combines the scores into final results, records exclusions and handles grievances, while every role only sees the records it is responsible for.
6ac93b1772de6872c88bbad4.problem: Journalism awards have many moving parts: per-branch eligibility rules and fees, jury committees with strict conflict-of-interest rules, weighted scoring and appeals. All of it has to be fair, consistent and traceable.
6ac93b1772de6872c88bbad4.solution: One system that covers the whole lifecycle, with automatic eligibility checks, a personal evaluation sheet for every juror, results calculated by the system, a grievance process and permissions scoped to each role.
features: Award cycles, types and branches, each with its own eligibility rules, fees, weighted criteria and winner ranks
Online applications with work uploads and fee payment (NBE, UPG, Momken or cash)
Automatic checks that the applicant is an active member and the branch is open
A jury committee per branch, with a personal evaluation sheet for every juror
Juror eligibility rules: syndicate membership, years on the practicing roll, no council seat, not applying in the same cycle
Scores combined into final percentages, ranked winners and recorded exclusions
Board of trustees, admin committees and assignments, each role limited to its own records

challenges.approach: Juror eligibility is checked automatically against membership, years on the practicing roll, council seats and same-cycle applications
Weighted criteria per branch, an individual evaluation sheet per juror, and final results calculated by the system instead of by hand
Role-based permissions that are scoped automatically, so each role only reaches its own records

69f64f0e7540e37c3b6892cf.title: Health Appointments
69f64f0e7540e37c3b6892cf.summary: Backend for a doctor-appointment platform: guest booking, real-time availability, smart search, reviews, reminders and medical history, in a modular NestJS monorepo.
69f64f0e7540e37c3b6892cf.description:
A backend API for a doctor-appointment platform. Patients can book as guests, see real-time availability, search and filter doctors, read reviews and check insurance coverage, while reminders, medical history and gamified rewards keep them engaged.
The code is a modular NestJS monorepo: separate deployable apps for the patient app, the admin dashboard, the customer portal and background jobs, all sharing the same business logic through common libraries on top of PostgreSQL and Redis.
69f64f0e7540e37c3b6892cf.problem: Booking a doctor is often slow and opaque: patients can't easily see who is available, which insurance is accepted or what other patients think, and appointments get forgotten.
69f64f0e7540e37c3b6892cf.solution: An API that exposes live availability, search, reviews and insurance data, lets guests book quickly and sends reminders, built as separate apps that share one set of business rules.
features: Guest booking without creating an account

challenges.challenge: Several apps sharing the same rules
challenges.approach: A monorepo where the patient, admin, customer and background-job apps reuse shared libraries for entities, services and repositories

challenges.challenge: Work that shouldn't slow down requests
challenges.approach: A dedicated background-processor app for scheduled and long-running jobs

69f64e377540e37c3b689263.title: Railway Reservation
69f64e377540e37c3b689263.summary: Backend for a railway reservation system: trains, schedules, routes and bookings, with email OTP sign-in, localized validation, rate limiting and structured logging.
69f64e377540e37c3b689263.description:
A modular, scalable backend for managing trains, schedules, routes and reservations. It handles passenger records and onboarding, and signs users in with email one-time passwords.
The API is built to run in production: validation errors come back in the user's language, every route is rate limited, logs are structured and rotated daily, and the whole stack runs in Docker with separate development and production setups.
69f64e377540e37c3b689263.problem: A reservation system serves many users at once and in more than one language. It needs secure sign-in, protection from abuse and logs that make production issues easy to trace.
69f64e377540e37c3b689263.solution: A NestJS and PostgreSQL API with email-OTP authentication, localized validation, global rate limiting and structured logging, packaged with Docker for consistent environments.
features: Structured logging with daily log rotation

challenges.approach: Validation messages are translated into the request's language
A global rate limit on every route
Structured logs written to daily-rotated files

6a106fe56f2586c202439e35.title: Super Fitness API
6a106fe56f2586c202439e35.summary: Fitness platform backend with personalized workouts, training programs and an AI coach chat powered by Gemini, streamed to users in real time.
6a106fe56f2586c202439e35.description:
A scalable fitness platform backend with a clean, modular architecture. Users get personalized workouts and exercises, category-based training programs and their own profiles, plus an AI chat powered by Gemini whose answers stream in as they are written.
Accounts are protected with JWT and refresh tokens, session management and role-based access. Media and workout videos are stored in Cloudinary, and the API follows security and performance best practices, with rate limiting, request validation, consistent error handling and Swagger documentation.
6a106fe56f2586c202439e35.problem: Fitness apps need personal plans, rich media and quick answers to users' questions, without compromising account security.
6a106fe56f2586c202439e35.solution: A modular NestJS and PostgreSQL backend with personalized workouts, Cloudinary-hosted media and an AI chat that streams Gemini's answers to the user as they are generated.
features: JWT authentication with refresh tokens and session management
AI coach chat powered by Gemini, streamed in real time
Media and video storage with Cloudinary
Security hardening: Helmet, CORS and rate limiting

challenges.approach: Responses are streamed to the client with Server-Sent Events instead of waiting for the full reply
Media is stored and delivered through Cloudinary

69f4da89d37be6d63f9e2b2e.title: E-commerce API
69f4da89d37be6d63f9e2b2e.summary: Production-style e-commerce backend with REST and GraphQL APIs, Stripe payments, real-time order updates and Redis caching.
69f4da89d37be6d63f9e2b2e.description:
A scalable e-commerce backend built with NestJS and MongoDB. It covers the full shop flow: accounts and roles, a product catalog, orders with search and filtering, and Stripe payments, with customers notified in real time as their order status changes.
It exposes both REST and GraphQL APIs, caches frequent reads in Redis, is covered by unit and end-to-end tests, and is ready to run in Docker.
69f4da89d37be6d63f9e2b2e.problem: An online store has to keep accounts secure, process payments reliably and stay fast as the catalog and traffic grow.
69f4da89d37be6d63f9e2b2e.solution: A layered NestJS API over MongoDB, with JWT and refresh tokens, role-based access, Stripe payments, WebSocket notifications and Redis caching.
features: Secure authentication with JWT and refresh tokens
Order lifecycle with pagination, filtering and search
Real-time order status notifications over WebSocket

challenges.approach: Order status changes are pushed to clients over WebSocket
Frequently read data is cached in Redis
A global interceptor shapes every error the same way
